title: Great rug for the price
text: Great rug for the price. I purchased the 5 x 7 size and very happy with color and quality.  Medium thickness but unrolled nicely.  I would recommend.

product_metadata.title: Home Dynamix Royalty Vega Contemporary Geometric Area Rug, Black/Brown, 7'8"x10'4"
features: MID-CENTURY MODERN INSPIRED STYLE: The layered rectangle design is true to the mid-century modern style with earth tone hues of black, brown and crimson red. The Royalty Vega collection will easily complement your existing home décor..Product Note : Rugs may contain temporary creases upon arrival, allow time for creases to flatten and settle
AVAILABLE IN A VARIETY OF AREA RUG SIZES: 9 x 12 rugs, 8x 10 rugs, 6 x 9 rugs, 5 x 7 rugs, 3 x 5 rugs, 2 x 3 rugs, 2 x 7 runner rugs, round area rugs
SOFT AND STRONG FIBERS: Machine woven construction of durable polypropylene yarns provides a cozy surface for your comfort needs while resisting in high traffic areas.
MODERNIZE ANY ROOM: This collection offers area rugs that are suitable for all indoor spaces. Living room rugs, bedroom rugs, rugs for the entryway, office rugs, dorm rugs.
EASY CARE MAINTENANCE: The upkeep of your polypropylene rug is simple and hassle-free. Shake, vacuum, or spot clean as needed.
description: Embellish your hardwood floors with the Royalty Vega rug collection. Inspired by mid-century modern style, this rug collection features a layered rectangle design with a distressed appeal in neutral earth tones. Well-constructed of heat set polypropylene, this rug repels stains while its cushiony fibers feel pleasant to your bare feet. Durable jute backing ensure to protect your floors from everyday wear and tear. Well-suited for high traffic areas in the home. Rug pad recommended.
